question: What ELF sections, debug information, symbols and disassembly remain available in the pinned historical image to implement a later ABI decoder?
decision_rule: INVENTORY_COMPLETE only after selected files and pinned ELF tools pass before/after hash checks, all tool processes exit zero, output digests are retained and owned children are absent. Missing DWARF/symbols are explicit unknowns. No layout/task-binding verdict.
stop_rule: One inventory; stop on answer, first identity/tool failure, STOP, signal or 300s deadline. No inference.
